Recce (pronounced "wreck-E") is short for "reconnaissance," a British military term that refers to the act of scouting ahead to gather information before taking action. That's exactly what our product is built for. Recce helps data teams look ahead before merging a pull request. It brings visibility to what changed, what's impacted, and what needs review. Just like a scout clears the path for the troops, Recce ensures your data is safe to ship.

The demand for AI will soon exceed our current computing capacity by a massive margin. Who can supply this much computing power is the trillion-dollar question. Relying solely on silicon chips could mean building entire nuclear facilities just to power millions of GPUs. OLIX (formerly Flux Computing) sees a more promising way forward: optical computing. By offering higher performance and consuming far less energy, optical solutions move beyond the physical constraints of silicon. We’re confident this new paradigm will shape the future of AI.
